detail.longDescription: 🐝 NEW: Researchers watched pollinators for 93 hours at five # Cambridge sites, each within 300 m of a # honeybee colony. Where hives were dense, other # pollinators were scarcer, and honey # bees won most encounters, pushing, chasing, and displacing rivals on bramble and ivy. One exception, the invasive ivy bee, sometimes fought back and won. 👉 https://www. sciencedaily.com/releases/2026 /10/261021231227.htm # bumblebees # hoverflies # beehives # beekeeping # ecology # climate # climatechange # flowers # conservation # wildlife # insects # nature # science # research
